notes: PegzeusToken (src/PegzeusToken.sol) is the launch's only contract: a plain fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 named Pegzeus, symbol PEGZEUS, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply, 1,000,000,000 PEGZEUS (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units), once to msg.sender, which on this launch is the factory. There is no mint function, owner, pause, blacklist, fee or burn on transfer, and no upgrade path, so the supply cannot grow and every transfer moves exactly the amount it names; the launch flows need no exemptions and the token takes none of the launch placeholders. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs PEGZEUS with imdUSD (0x61aaf8a992a3143e2b0c9cb0030b9fe702854a25) at the launch policy's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
